judged_claims.claim: The aircraft is the Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress: Miss Liberty Belle (serial 44-83690), a B-17G, was modified postwar to serve with the United States Air Force as a drone director DB-17P before being retired in 1958.
The name connection is that Vega Aircraft Corporation partnered with Boeing and Douglas to produce the Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress.
